integrity: Mathematical claims in the result, abstract and structured review agree. Independent verification has not been performed; accompanying code checks 28 finite parameter instances while the mathematical argument handles all integers L,q>=2.
scientific_limitations: Classification covers the existence, smallest cardinality, and all minimum independent resolving sets of labeled Cartesian path–clique graphs only; no polynomial for larger resolving sets or arbitrary graph products is asserted. Finite BFS checks are not infinite proof. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Independent resolving bases of clique-path Cartesian graphs
